geometry.normals: part-local ModelBox axis normals through ModelRenderer+entity rotations

color_path.sample: GL_NEAREST pure floor (CrShadeCtx.sample_mode=1); terrain keeps floor(u*w-1e-4)
color_path.primary_gap: oracle L8 differs from round(L*255) by -1 on several face bins (e.g. pose1 -Z 211 vs 210)

gate_contract.chrome: bit-exact (diff <= A/B noise + 1e-6); A/B noise near-zero required
gate_contract.preview: PASS only if bit-exact; residual is open FAIL (no PASS-FLOOR budget)
gate_contract.claim_pixel_perfect: only when residual at J-vs-J noise floor and hard_px==0

residual.description: Measured magma-vs-Java preview residual under pin. Not a pass allowance.
residual.cause: ubyte primary L8 off-by-one on some StandardItemLighting faces after packing (tex*L8+127)/255
